question: What tower width is prescribed when the upper story is divided into nine parts?
premises: The upper story above that is divided into nine parts.
The tower width is specified in this division.
The tower width is one śiva-part.
inference: When that upper story is divided into nine parts, the tower width is one śiva-part.
plain_english: When the story above that is divided into nine parts, the tower width should be one śiva-part.
